method: Recompute exact component semantics, nonempty-mask List-3 reduction, monotonicity, and finite message-language bounds without importing the primary result's conclusion.

semantics: Current residual Y0 is anticomplete to the current seed, so current seed colors do not constrain C.
All fixed X0 effects are exactly vertex-local and absorbed into B_C(u)=[4]\f(N(u)∩X0).
Axiom (iv) on a connected C implies every dynamic outside vertex is complete or anticomplete to C.
Hence dynamic outside influence factors exactly through F_C(c), the set of colors on complete dynamic neighbors.
list3: D_C nonempty implies every reachable F_C(c) nonempty.
For nonempty F, every L_F(u) lies inside [4]\F, a palette of size at most three.
G[C] is P7-free as an induced subgraph.
Thus constructive P7-free List-3 computes mu_C(F) and a witness for each of at most 15 nonempty masks.
monotonicity: If F subseteq F' and a coloring avoids F', it also avoids F.
Therefore good masks form a down-set and bad masks form an upset.
branch_logic: All 15 nonempty masks bad => no reachable F can pass because D_C is nonempty => exact branch UNSAT.
At least one nonempty mask good => empty mask is good by monotonicity => all 16 table entries known.
finite_language: Independent exhaustive finite checker returns 168 downward-closed good-mask families on 2^[4].
Maximum number of inclusion-minimal bad masks is 6, matching Sperner's bound C(4,2)=6.

limitations: Joint composition of many messages remains open.
Finite alphabet alone is not a polynomial global solver.
